title: role.yaml — the role contract implemented by a role pack

task_types.description: task types the planner may route to this role

builders.description: task type → specialist builder agent (green phase); other types use builder

architect.description: joins the architecture stage (role:architect) for this role's design

audits.description: engine audits at verification: a node script from the role pack, run in the role's folder on the change set; it prints a JSON array of review findings { file?, line?, rule, severity, claim, evidence? }

node.description: script path relative to the role pack

files.description: regex on the changed files to pass (default: all but tests)

args.description: arguments; {files} = the matching changed files (the default), {<artifact type>} = that feature artifact's path (the audit is skipped without it)

checks.description: extra gate-impl steps for this role: a stack command or a node script in the role pack

node.description: a script path relative to the role pack; run in the role's folder with --project <role folder> --files <task files relative to it>

task_types.description: only for these task types (default: all)

report.description: the command writes a Vitest JSON report to {report}; failed tests fail the gate

allow_skipped.description: skipped tests or an empty report pass (default false); a project can set quality.allow_skipped_checks

per_ac.description: with a report: when tests ran, each AC the task satisfies needs a passing test whose name has the AC id

at_verify.description: also run the whole command once at verification (gate-checks); task gates run only what the change touches
